stories.title: How Bradley Braves basketball lost road opener at Davidson, prep for Coppin State duel next
stories.summary: The Bradley Braves men's team lost their season road opener at Davidson on Nov. 10. They move on to face Coppin State next in a tourney in Florida. The Braves lost their season road opener, 62-45, before 2,036 at Belk Arena in Davidson , N.C. The Braves slipped to 1-2 on the season, while Davidson moved to 3-0. Bradley, an 11.5-point underdog heading into the game, chipped a deficit down to four points in the second half before fading. The game marked the opening of a three-game trip this week, which continues with matchups against Coppin State and George Mason on Thursday and Saturday, respectively, in the Showdown in St. Pete at St. Petersburg, Fla.
